title: The Role of Subthreshold Micropulse Yellow Laser as an Alternative Option for the Treatment of Refractory Postoperative Cystoid Macular Edema

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license)

groups.agent: 577 nm subthreshold micropulse yellow laser (5% duty cycle, confluent 7 x 7 grids covering the edema including the foveal center)
groups.description: Chronic postoperative cystoid macular edema after uncomplicated or complicated cataract surgery or retinal detachment surgery, refractory to conventional treatments for at least 4 months, no earlier SMYL; SMYL repeated on relapse

series.notes: mean +/- SD (caption: 'Mean values'); per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: Per-eye rows give only the baseline value and no follow-up, so they form no series; the tabulated group mean (t002) is extracted (brief ruling on per-eye rows).

exclusions.what: Subgroups by surgery type (uncomplicated cataract, complicated cataract, retinal detachment surgery)
exclusions.reason: Shown only in a figure, not tabulated.

exclusions.what: t002 CMT column and p-value columns
exclusions.reason: Retinal thickness and p-values are not extracted.

notes: BCVA was evaluated with ETDRS charts, assessed in Snellen and converted to logMAR (Methods); t002 states LogMAR with no Snellen row.
Values were recorded at 1, 2, 3 and 6 months after laser treatment (Methods); relapses are described relative to the initial laser intervention, so months are counted from the first SMYL session.
Two eyes were re-treated with SMYL after a relapse (one of them three sessions, its last follow-up stated relative to the third session); values were not removed or replaced.
Bromfenac 0.09% eye drops were prescribed for one month after the intervention in all eyes.
Earlier treatments: topical NSAIDs in all eyes and, in some, oral NSAIDs, sub-Tenon triamcinolone, dexamethasone implant or anti-VEGF (t001).
Role treated: the article presents SMYL as a technique without earlier reports for this indication, evaluated as an alternative to standard therapies.
The comparisons used nonparametric tests; the caption labels the tabulated values as means.
